decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - Reason (Condition 24)

The details submitted pursuant to condition 24 (exterior lighting) of planning permission 00657/P/P13 dated 1 July 2010; for 164 residential units, ancillary fitness suite and business centre, retail (Class A1 use) caf?/restaurant (Class A3 use) office (Class B1 use) and Public House (Class A4 use) together with access, public and private open space, basement car and cycle parking provision, public convenience, provision of a pontoon and use of arches 4 & 5 under Kew Bridge for boat club (Class D2 use), are considered to meet the requirements of the condition and relevant policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development) and ENV-P.1.7 (Light Pollution) and ENV-P.1.6 (Air Pollution) of the adopted Unitary Development Plan.

Reason (Condition 28)

The details submitted pursuant to condition 28 (Delivery and Servicing Plan) of planning permission 00657/P/P13 dated 1 July 2010; for 164 residential units, ancillary fitness suite and business centre, retail (Class A1 use) caf?/restaurant (Class A3 use) office (Class B1 use) and Public House (Class A4 use) together with access, public and private open space, basement car and cycle parking provision, public convenience, provision of a pontoon and use of arches 4 & 5 under Kew Bridge for boat club (Class D2 use), are considered to meet the requirements of the condition and relevant policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development) and T.1.4 (Car & Cycle Parking & Servicing for Developments) of the adopted Unitary Development Plan.
description: Details of exterior lighting required by condition 24, and details of Delivery and Servicing Plan required by condition 28 of planning permission 00657/P/P13 dated 01/07/2010 for 164 residential units, ancillary fitness suite and business centre, retail (Class A1 use) caf?/restaurant (Class A3 use) office (Class B1 use) and Public House (Class A4 use) together with access, public and private open space, basement car and cycle parking provision, public convenience, provision of a pontoon and use of arches 4 & 5 under Kew Bridge for boat club (Class D2 use).
